mechanics: Call 0x01021300 with no arguments and compare its EAX pointer with the hidden species pointer.

Only when the pointer matches and the stack profile is non-null, initialize the first local record to 0x01667bac, 0x01667bac, 0x01667bae, prepare the profile with the first local record, call the cdecl star-manager getter, and pass the same local record pointer to 0x00bb5b50.
Initialize a three-word local color to zero, then copy profile words at offsets 0x504, 0x508, and 0x50c when the profile is non-null.
Compute the species vector count from the end-minus-begin pointer words shifted right by two and call 0x00bb9b90 once per positive element with the local color.

When profile is non-null, call 0x00c32cd0 with the first local record, initialize the second local record, prepare the profile with that second record, call 0x00b6f380 on species+0x0c with the second record, traverse the opaque name tree, and assign the selected UTF-16 range to species+0x3c through 0x00423650.
For each directly visible local record, call 0x00f47380 only when its third-minus-first distance is greater than two after clearing bit zero and its first word is non-null.
Restore EBX, EBP, ESI, and EDI, remove the 0x2c frame, and return with RET 0x4.

call_order.condition: current pointer equals species and profile is non-null
local range is non-empty under the visible distance test

mechanics_scope.current_empire: The current-empire pointer is queried once and compared by raw pointer identity; the current branch is skipped for a distinct pointer or a null profile.
mechanics_scope.profile_and_color: The profile argument is kept distinct from the species receiver; its three words at 0x504..0x50c are copied into a local color only for the vector calls.
mechanics_scope.vector: An empty range performs no vector helper calls; a nonempty range calls the vector helper in element order.
mechanics_scope.name: The name state call precedes the tree traversal and UTF-16 range assignment; the species target at 0x3c is passed as the receiver to 0x00423650.
mechanics_scope.cleanup: The fixed local records have third-minus-first equal to two, so the direct 0x00f47380 cleanup calls are not taken in the fixed-constant paths.
mechanics_scope.uninitialized_path: When the current pointer is distinct, the first local record is not initialized before 0x00c32cd0; the model forwards its address without inventing contents.
mechanics_scope.state_events_containers: The target does not directly dispatch UI, communication, persistence, or event operations. Color, vector, name-state, name assignment, and cleanup remain separate ports and layout regions.

evidence.observation: Assembly proves hidden species in ECX, one stack profile at entry ESP+0x04, 0x2c frame, current-pointer branch, color copy, vector loop, name traversal, and RET 0x4.
Vector helper is thiscall with one stack color range and writes three words at receiver offsets 0x74, 0x78, and 0x7c.
Name assignment is thiscall with begin/end stack words and RET 0x8.
Cleanup helper accepts one cdecl pointer and itself has a plain RET; the caller performs the visible range test.
Five direct call-site xrefs are reported.
